Title: Login error message is not fully visible
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open SauceDemo 
2. Enter an invalid username and password 
3. Click Login 
4. Observe the displayed error message
Expected Result: The complete error message should be clearly visible to the user
Actual Result: The login error message is partially hidden/not fully visible
Impact: Users may not be able to read the complete error message, making it dificult to understand the login failure

Title: Product page UI elements are misaligned
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login with visual_user 
2. Navigate to the Products page 
3. Observe the product cards and navigation elements
Expected Result: Add to Cart buttons, shopping cart icon, and menu icon should be properly and consistently aligned
Actual Result: UI elements are incorrectly aligned, including the bottom-right Add to Cart button, shopping cart icon, and menu icon
Impact: Reduces UI consistency and negatively affects the overall user experience

Title: Product price changes after clicking All Items
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login with visual_user 
2. see the price of the affected product 
3. Click All Items 
4. Check the same product price
Expected Result: The product price should remain consistent when navigating back to All Items
Actual Result: The product price changes after clicking All Items
Impact: Incorrect pricing can mislead users and may result in incorrect purchase or checkout amounts

Title: Product image and details do not match for problem_user
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login with problem_user 
2. Open the Products page 
3. Compare product names and images 
4. Click an affected product 
5. Compare the listing with the Product Details page
Expected Result: Product image, name, and details should correspond to the selected product
Actual Result: The product image/details shown on the product listing do not correctly match the product information shown on the Product Details page
Impact: Users may be shown incorrect product information, reducing trust and potentially affecting purchase decisions

Title: Performance glitch user is redirected to a product details page after login
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open SauceDemo 
2. Login with performance_glitch_user 
3. Observe the page displayed immediately after successful login
Expected Result: User should be redirected to the Products/Home page after successful login
Actual Result: User is redirected directly to a Product Details page instead of the expected Products/Home page
Impact: Unexpected navigation can confuse users and disrupt the normal post-login user journey
